mapper.select: SELECT g.id,g.name,g.description,g.cover,g.shoot_date AS shootDate,g.sort,DATE_FORMAT(g.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_photo p WHERE p.gallery_id=g.id AND p.deleted=0) AS photoCount FROM t_gallery g WHERE g.deleted=0 AND g.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.keyword},'%') ORDER BY g.sort ASC,g.create_time DESC,g.id DESC
